title: Send Feedback
intro: Quico, who makes Murmur, reads it. Every message helps decide what comes next.

question.other: What would you like to tell us?

placeholder.bug: What you were doing, what you expected and what happened. If it always happens, how to make it happen again.
placeholder.idea: What you'd like Murmur to do, and what it would help you with.

emailHint: Only to answer you. If you leave it empty, the message arrives without knowing who sent it.
log: Attach Murmur's log from the last 24 hours
goesWith: Also sent: {{app}}, {{system}}, {{machine}} and the interface in {{language}}
never: Never anything from your meetings: no titles, text, names or audio.
sentText: I read everything, even if I can't always answer.
sentWithEmail: I read everything. If needed, I'll answer at the email you left.
queuedTitle: It'll be sent when there's a connection
queuedText: This computer has no connection right now. The message stays here and goes on its own the next time you open Murmur with a connection.
tooMany: You've sent a few in a row. Wait a while and try again.
